Subject: Post-call recap + proposed slots for technical deep dive

Hi Nate / Linda —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the deep-dive session: 

Summary (2 min)
- Primary use case: prefix caching + multi-tenant inference for clinical summaries.
- Key non-functional reqs: 100ms p95 for short completions, SOC 2 evidence for ingest, VPC/connectivity for PHI-hinted workloads.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep dive to review architecture, sample data flow, and capacity sizing. Please confirm which of these windows work for your engineering team (all times ET):
- Option A: Tue Aug 24, 11:00–12:00 ET
- Option B: Wed Aug 25, 15:00–16:00 ET

Agenda (draft)
1) 10m: goals + success criteria
2) 20m: demo of a similar integration (KV cache demo + batching settings)
3) 20m: infra/discovery Qs (networking, KMS, retention)
4) 10m: next steps & ownership (MAP review)

Please: 1) pick a slot, 2) confirm the attendees you want in the meeting (engineer(s) + security contact if possible), and 3) state preference for Zoom vs Google Meet.

Attaching a one-page Mutual Action Plan and the discovery notes from today so everyone has the context.

Thanks — I can send the calendar invite once you confirm the time and attendee list.

Best,
